nodes.label: Supabase database schema
nodes.author: PC Master LMS Team
nodes.rationale: Core tables: profiles + student_code, classes + class_members, lessons / lesson_sections, quizzes (title, time_limit_minutes, max_attempts, is_published), exam_attempts, exam_logs, discussion_threads / discussion_replies with trigger update_reply_count.

nodes.label: Parent realtime rules P01-P06
nodes.author: PC Master LMS Team
nodes.rationale: Realtime governance for parents: P01 connection status heartbeat, P02 student_code charset restriction, P03 data isolation between families, P04 channel cleanup, P05-P06 authorization. Defines who receives updates and how channels are secured.
